subject.title: fix(fleet): gateway token is echoed raw to the terminal in create and restore commands

question: Should the default interactive fleet commands continue to display a newly generated gateway token once, with redaction limited to redirected/piped output, or should OpenClaw add an explicit secure retrieval flow before always masking it?
rationale: The patch resolves terminal persistence concerns but breaks the documented one-time handoff used to configure a fleet container; choosing the permanent credential-delivery policy is product and security-boundary intent, not a mechanical review choice.

options.title: Keep raw interactive delivery
options.body: Show the token once when stdout is a TTY and redact it for redirected or piped output, with tests for both behaviors.

options.title: Always mask with secure retrieval
options.body: Keep masking everywhere only after adding and documenting an explicit secure way for an operator to retrieve and store a generated token.

recommendation.title: Keep raw interactive delivery
recommendation.body: Show the token once when stdout is a TTY and redact it for redirected or piped output, with tests for both behaviors.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review traces the concrete fleet CLI and service contract that the decision must preserve or replace.
